answer: Require one employer-verified payslip with a matching tax record per identity: a real job at a registered employer, confirmed against payroll data. A payslip cannot be faked like pigment on paper — the river of payroll runs every month, and the record is hard as quartz to forge. Each fake needs a real employer and a real salary of about $3,000 a month, so 100 fakes cost about $300,000 every month, and the bill rises with every fake added.
